hooks.command: CMD=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',d).get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null || true); case "$CMD" in *git\ push*) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"additionalContext":"Reminder: did you run php artisan test before pushing?"}}' ;; esac

CMD=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',d).get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null || true); case "$CMD" in *artisan\ migrate) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"additionalContext":"Reminder: if this migration touches leads_master, lead_cycles, lead_activity_logs, or waybills — update warehouseops-v5/CLAUDE.md Known Gotchas."}}' ;; esac
